published_baseline: Founder-approved Geomacro Commercial V1 website with concise buyer-first desktop and mobile navigation; live Intelligence, separate Risk Indices, Critical Minerals and Rare Earth Risk, Ask Geomacro, institutional workflows, governed API and agent access, dedicated Pricing, and Risk Gate boundaries remain clearly separated from technical-proof surfaces. Pricing has its own /pricing route rather than redirecting customers into API & Agents. Ask Geomacro retains the dedicated same-origin, read-only /api/public-ask transport approved in the prior baseline, including origin validation, injection rejection, bounded input and warm-runtime rate limiting. Intelligence and Risk Indices browser refreshes now use explicit /api/public/intelligence and /api/public/risk-indices boundaries instead of opaque TanStack server-function transport, so customer-facing reads remain independent of the standby Supabase distributed ledger. Durable verified intelligence and risk packages remain B2-authoritative. When the verified Intelligence continuity package is older than the live window, the public Intelligence API may add a bounded ephemeral GDELT discovery overlay; those rows are visibly labelled live observed and remain unscored with null severity and movement until the durable verification pipeline certifies them, and they are not written to B2 or Supabase by the serving path. Production health now fails when Intelligence has no observation within 24 hours and functionally probes the canonical Ask and Risk Indices public APIs. No Supabase customer-serving fallback is introduced. Homepage remains pricing-free; Free Explorer and the 0.05 USDC x402 first-20,000 successful paid-delivery offer remain on dedicated Pricing/API surfaces. Customer Care and contact@geomacro.live remain the human support escalation path. x402 production activation remains separately fail-closed and controlled.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
